authorization: Owner instruction P61.2 (2026-11-10): implement deterministic, evidence-backed aliases only where the canonical identity and unit are unambiguous. Synthetic intake recognition only; this is not scientific approval, not catalog activation and never applies to real data.
rules: The target is an ACTIVE entry of this mission's verified SYNTHETIC DEMO catalog whose display name, unit and domain equal the values recorded here; otherwise the alias is ignored.
The incoming unit must equal the entry's unit byte-for-byte. No unit or value conversion and no unit-notation equivalence (for example 'deg C' vs '°C') is ever applied.
An alias is used only when no production, handbook, governed-extension or demo entry already matches the label, and never when it equals the name or alias of another active entry.
Equivalence must be a curated abbreviation or word-order form of the same analyte; substring or fuzzy similarity is never sufficient.

aliases.evidence: '25-OH' is the standard abbreviation of '25-hydroxy'; the entry's own signed alias '25(OH) Vitamin D' uses the same abbreviation. Identical unit ng/mL. Production bone-019 '25(OH) Vitamin D' defines no unit and cannot be matched.
'BP' abbreviates 'blood pressure'. Identical unit mmHg. The owner-directed P59 synthetic mapping already relates this entry to production cv-005 SBP (mmHg).
